resolved_findings.title: Initial input-length sweep exceeded the linked profile context caps
resolved_findings.location: reports/EXPERIMENTS.md:53 and benchmarks/PROTOCOL.md minimum experiment matrix
evidence: Qwen 27B, Gemma 31B and Mistral starting profiles cap total context at 32768 tokens.
A full 32K-token input plus generated output exceeds a 32768-token context; the same issue applies to a full 64K input at a 65536 cap.
resolved_findings.impact: Invalid or truncated requests could contaminate correctness and service results before a larger-context configuration was qualified.
resolved_findings.fix_verified: The roadmap and protocol now constrain every point by complete serialized input plus requested output against actual model/profile caps, with reduce/skip behavior and separate qualification for cap increases.

resolved_recommendations.title: Define uncertainty on the comparison effect
resolved_recommendations.evidence: The promotion paragraph currently says overlapping baseline and candidate observed variation is inconclusive; the template stores run_to_run_uncertainty after the run but does not predeclare the analysis method.
resolved_recommendations.rationale: Overlap of raw ranges or separate intervals does not establish whether an improvement exceeds the minimum useful difference, especially with paired or blocked A/B runs.
resolved_recommendations.suggested_change: Predeclare the comparison estimator and uncertainty method, evaluate uncertainty of the candidate-minus-baseline difference or ratio against the minimum useful improvement, and retain inconclusive when the evidence cannot resolve that threshold. This is a methodological clarification, not evidence of false performance claims.
resolved_recommendations.fix_verified: The roadmap now predeclares pairing/aggregation and uncertainty estimation, evaluates uncertainty on the improvement against the useful-improvement threshold, and explicitly rejects raw-range overlap as the decision rule. The template adds analysis_method_and_uncertainty and repetition_pairing_or_aggregation.
